The '''Shiphand cargo skiff''' was a model of [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] built by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]] for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 12,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
